name: umbrella
description: Connects Claude Code to an Umbraco 17 site through the umbrella-mcp server: the CMS tools, plus Forms, Automate and Engage when the site has them.

base_url.title: Site address
base_url.description: The https address of your Umbraco site, for example https://www.example.com. Settings → Umbrella → Overview in the backoffice shows it.

client_id.title: Client id
client_id.description: The client id of your API user, from its client credentials in the backoffice.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: The client secret you saved when you added the API user's client credentials. Kept in your system's credential store.

tls_reject_unauthorized.title: Check the site's HTTPS certificate
tls_reject_unauthorized.description: Leave at 1. Set 0 only for a site on your own machine that uses the ASP.NET Core development certificate: it turns off certificate checks for this MCP server.
